text1: Please arrive at the Town Hall by 9:45am, for a 10am start. We don't want you to miss the ceremony!
text2: After the ceremony, we will head over to The Spread Eagle via the iconic London Overground.
text3: Arrival to The Spread Eagle, a quintessential British corner pub for a delicious plant-based lunch and a cool, relaxed wedding reception.
text4: We hope you have had a wonderful time and thank you for being a part of our special day!
